blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) appealed to Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, a former nationalpolicechief, to voluntarily surrender to prevent harm to uniformed personnel. “Kung sa puso niya ay gayun pa ang kanyang pagiging tatay ng Philippine National Police, alam ko hindi niya hahayaan na mayroon isa o dalawa o 10 members of the Philippine National Police ang masaktan,” Lt. Gen. Wilson Joseph Lopez, PNP deputy chief for administration, told reporters in a press briefing at Camp Crame.
